title: Lehman Brothers collapses
narration: In the week of 2008-09-19, the Financials sector fell 0.3%, while the whole market moved -0.2%. Market fear was stressed (VIX 32). Sectors were partly moving together.

title: The worst week of 2008
narration: In the week of 2008-10-10, the market fell 19.9%. Market fear was crisis level (VIX 70). Sectors were moving almost in lockstep, so diversification offered little shelter.

title: US credit rating downgraded
narration: In the week of 2011-08-12, the market fell 2.3%. Market fear was stressed (VIX 36). Sectors were moving almost in lockstep, so diversification offered little shelter.

title: China devaluation sell-off
narration: In the week of 2015-08-21, the market fell 6.6%. Market fear was nervous (VIX 28). Sectors were partly moving together.

title: Volatility spike
narration: In the week of 2018-02-09, the market fell 5.9%. Market fear was nervous (VIX 29). Sectors were moving almost in lockstep, so diversification offered little shelter.

title: COVID-19 crash
narration: In the week of 2020-03-20, the market fell 14.9%. Market fear was crisis level (VIX 66). Sectors were moving almost in lockstep, so diversification offered little shelter.

title: Rate-hike bear market
narration: In the week of 2022-06-17, the market fell 5.9%. Market fear was stressed (VIX 31). Sectors were partly moving together.

title: The AI boom lifts tech
narration: In the week of 2023-05-26, NVDA rose 24.6%, while the whole market moved +0.3%. Market fear was normal (VIX 18). Sectors were moving fairly independently.
